# omnibias

> Numerically-stable closed-form n-th derivative forward-pass framework.
> omnibias computes `sigma^(n)(z)` (the n-th derivative of an activation)
> in closed form for arbitrary `n`, with bit-stable accuracy and one
> `sigma` evaluation regardless of order. The same primitive runs on
> PyTorch, JAX, and Keras 3, with bit-identical coefficients shared from
> one pure-Python core module.

Operator surface: `OperatorBlock` dispatches on six roles --
`identity | grad | laplacian | derivative | band | integral`. `grad` /
`laplacian` / `derivative` are closed-form `sigma^(n)`; **`integral` is a
closed-form antiderivative window** `S(z+b_hi)-S(z+b_lo)` with `S'=sigma` (the
`ActivationSpec.integral` kernel, e.g. `sigmoid`'s antiderivative is
`softplus`), and `band` is the literal window `sigma(z+b_hi)-sigma(z+b_lo)`.
omnibias has a closed-form integral operator, not only closed-form derivatives.
"Integral" has three senses -- activation antiderivative (above), domain
quadrature (`omnibias-fields`), and the measure integral `integral f dmu`
(`omnibias-measure`, with a certified variant in `omnibias-verify`). Canonical
capability matrix: `docs/operator-surface.md`.

The dictionary also carries **closed-form integral transforms** of the
activations whose transform is itself elementary
(`omnibias.{torch,jax}.transforms`; the identity table, the regions of
convergence and the reasons for every gap live in the pure-Python
`omnibias.core.transforms`). Laplace for `exp` / `relu` / `sin` / `cos` /
`sinh` / `cosh` / `gaussian` / `sigmoid` / `tanh` / `sech`, Fourier for the two
self-reciprocal profiles `gaussian` and `sech`, Mellin for `gaussian`, plus
`fermi_dirac_mellin` (`Gamma(s) eta(s)`, the Mellin transform of the
*complementary* sigmoid, restricted to `Re(s) > 1` to match the verified
`dirichlet` zeta scope). `ActivationSpec.transforms` holds them,
`tempered()` propagates them by exact beta-scaling laws, and
`TransformBlock` / `LaplaceTransform` / `FourierTransform` / `MellinTransform`
make a transform a trainable layer whose learnable spectral variable is
softplus-reparameterised to stay inside the region of convergence. Gaps are
deliberate and labelled (`relu` / `sigmoid` / `tanh` have no Fourier kernel:
they are not `L^1` and their transforms are distributional; `exp` has no Mellin
kernel because omnibias's `exp` is `e^{+z}`, not the decaying `e^{-z}` of the
`Gamma(s)` pair). Example: `docs/examples/transforms_closed_form.py`.

omnibias is a uv-workspace monorepo. The stable workspace is
`omnibias-core` + `omnibias-torch` + `omnibias-jax` + `omnibias-ferminet`;
`omnibias-keras` is a Keras 3 unified backend. Scientific extensions:
`omnibias-fields` (the foundational field substrate: `FieldState`, the
attribute-DSL views, the lazy sigma cache, and the torch/jax field-operator
surface incl. integration, line integrals (the gradient theorem), norms,
tensor divergence, Wirtinger),
`omnibias-pinn` and `omnibias-qpinn` (physics-informed / quantum PINNs, built on
the field substrate). CCF line discovery uses a Cauchy–Hardy exact-Hilbert
basis (`omnibias.core.verified.hardy_line`, `hilbert_mode="hardy_exact"`) with a
whole-line CAP attempt (`ccf_hardy_wholeline_blowup`; `whole_line_certified` only
on genuine covering + NK close), vorticity-form Rung-1 metric
(`omnibias.pinn.jax.discovery.ccf_vorticity`), sealed Galerkin spectrum,
and a fractional dissipation threshold certificate; reusable via
`omnibias.pinn.jax.discovery.pipeline`. Absolute Rung-1/Rung-2 gates are not
forged — smoke/acceptance report earned only when dense residual and CAP close.
Clay NS / Yang–Mills parents stay
external obligations (`navier_stokes_proof_claim=False`).
`omnibias-fields`; hosts `omnibias.pinn.operator` for neural operator learning
(DeepONet with closed-form trunk-jet query derivatives through order 4, so a
shipped KS residual runs unchanged on one jet; multi-head `ConditioningSpec` for
parameters / BC / geometry with a width-1 parameter-head LayerNorm guard; FNO1d/FNO2d
FFT baseline; `ks_residual_loss_fd` is the 5-point FD twin for the bake-off;
Burgers closed-form-vs-FD is an honest negative at 1st-order-in-time, KS is
seed-fragile on median (5/8) against the ≥6/8 rule; FNO baseline stays FFT-based;
residual enclosure is not a solution-error bound; accuracy is optimised not proven;
zero-shot parametric heat gate closed in `benchmarks/operator_zero_shot.py` with
ETDRK4 / maximum-principle reference); also `omnibias.pinn.train` (gated causal
marching; heat vs Krishnapriyan reaction families in `benchmarks/causal_marching.py`),
`omnibias.pinn.domain` (SDF hard cages), and one-shot `solve_least_squares` /
`benchmarks/spectral_bias_fbpinn.py`; absolute gates via `benchmarks/_gates.py`
with smoke `*_smoke.json` vs `--full` acceptance JSON; matrix at
`docs/benchmarks/pinn_four_gap_matrix.md`; the
prebuilt residuals now include two **nonlocal** ones,
`Fredholm` and `Volterra` integral equations, which re-evaluate the field at the
quadrature nodes -- free, since an omnibias field is a function -- with the causal
variant kept mesh-free by an affine pullback onto a single reference rule),

`omnibias-curvature` (closed-form Hessian/Fisher/KFAC, plus the
`eps -> 0` rank/regularization collapse: a min-norm / Tikhonov solver with a certified
conditioning bound in `omnibias.core.verified.conditioning`),
`omnibias-geometry` (differential geometry: metric, Christoffel, Laplace-Beltrami,
curvature, geodesics, exterior calculus, and surface integration of differential
forms over charts), `omnibias-fractional` (fractional calculus in two honest
classes: grid/spectral GL / RL / Caputo -- non-local, numerical -- and a
*closed-form* analytic fractional derivative on the analytic-function class, now
extended with multi-terminal piecewise-analytic patching, activation-specific
special-function closed forms (Mittag-Leffler / polylog / Lerch / incomplete
gamma for exp / cosh / sinh), a two-sided non-periodic spectral fractional
Laplacian (DST-I / DCT-II) + windowed variant, and trainable torch/jax
fractional layers with a learnable order; all three are also exposed as
**equation-discovery columns** in `omnibias-symbolic`
(`build_jet_{piecewise,activation,spectral}_fractional_features`, labelled closed
form / closed form / numerical-spectral, wired into `NeuralJetDiscoverer`)),
`omnibias-measure` (autograd-native measure-theoretic integration: the third of
omnibias's three senses of "integral" -- not the closed-form activation
antiderivative window nor field domain quadrature but the measure integral
`integral f dmu` against a discrete `Measure` (with pushforward / product /
Radon-Nikodym reweight / normalize), plus (self-normalized) importance-sampling
expectations, the layer-cake / distribution-function formula
`integral f dmu = integral_0^inf mu({f>t}) dt` with a soft `sigmoid(beta(f-t))`
superlevel indicator off the closed-form sigmoid tower, and the from-below
simple-function construction; bit-identical numpy `_core` + torch/jax twins with
trainable `LebesgueIntegral` / `ExpectationLayer` / `LayerCakeIntegral` layers,
reusing the `omnibias-fields` quadrature rules; and a `pointprocess` submodule --
neural temporal point processes + right-censored survival, whose compensator
`int lambda` / cumulative hazard is the general Gauss-Legendre measure quadrature
or, for an OMBU intensity `scale*act(w t+b)`, the exact closed-form antiderivative
window `(scale/w)[S(wT+b)-S(w t0+b)]` with `S'=act` (`sigmoid`->`softplus`), giving
an exact log-likelihood + a trainable `TemporalPointProcess`; its quadrature also
supplies the **integral columns** in `omnibias-symbolic`
(`build_jet_integral_features` running / Fredholm / Volterra +
`measure_integral_columns` for field laws), the first non-local candidate library
there and so the first that can express an integro-differential law; and an
`integraleq` submodule -- Fredholm / Volterra **integral equations of the second
kind** `u = f + lam integral K(x,t) u(t) dmu(t)`, the mirror image of a
differential equation, where Nystrom discretisation is nearly free because a
`Measure` already is the nodes and weights of `(I - lam K W) u = f`:
`nystrom_solve` (numerical at the measure's own order, spectral for
Gauss-Legendre), `volterra_solve` (causal, triangular, always solvable),
`neumann_series` (valid only for `|lam| rho(KW) < 1`, returning a `NeumannResult`
whose `converged` flag is earned by the measured residual rather than assumed),
`degenerate_kernel_solve` (finite rank, **exact in the kernel**, the analytic
oracle) and `fredholm_residual`; the direct solvers refuse a **Fredholm
alternative** via `solvability_margin` = `sigma_min/max(1,sigma_max)`, not the
scale-invariant condition number, because a near-eigenvalue solve otherwise
returns a huge finite vector that looks like an answer),
`omnibias-score`
(score / Ito-generator / Fokker-Planck, composed from `omnibias-fields`),
`omnibias-variational` (least action: action integrals, Euler-Lagrange
residuals, Hamiltonian/Noether machinery, classical field theory,
geodesics-as-least-action, symplectic integrators, forward Lagrangian dynamics
for Lagrangian Neural Networks, the Legendre transform to the Hamiltonian with
canonical equations, and rigorous action enclosures),
`omnibias-shape` (differentiable soft shape / occupancy fields + soft-OR /
log-sum-exp coverage with a closed-form gradient/Hessian tower, turning discrete
geometric covering -- e.g. minimum-square-cover -- into a second-order-optimizable
energy; torch + jax),
`omnibias-binary` (closed-form quantization gradients for binary / ternary /
k-bit training via the tanh-beta Riccati derivative; torch + jax),
`omnibias-spiking` (spiking LIF / IF primitives with exact closed-form surrogate
gradients off the activation dictionary; torch + jax),
`omnibias-hopfield` (modern Hopfield / attention-as-operator with a closed-form
log-sum-exp Jacobian / Hessian; torch + jax), and
`omnibias-formal` (Mathlib-backed formal certificate checking: discharges a
certificate's rational obligations -- enclosed-quantity sign, positive-definite
pivots, and the Newton-Kantorovich / Krawczyk contraction polynomial inequalities
-- against Mathlib, wires a `mathlib_verified` verdict tier distinct from the
Mathlib-free Lean kernel, exposes a deterministic loop driver `drive_obligation`
(classify -> generate -> `lake build` -> report) behind the `omnibias-dev-formal-agent`
skill; every Lean module is `sorry`-free and the scope is finite rational
obligations only), and
`omnibias-sos` (certified *universal* positivity by optimization: sound
Sum-of-Squares / Positivstellensatz decompositions and the auxiliary-functional /
background method for `for all data` bounds on polynomial ODE / Galerkin-truncated
systems -- a floating-point SDP proposes a Gram matrix and a rigorous interval
`LDL^T` positive-definiteness certificate proves it, reusing `omnibias.core.verified`
and the Mathlib-free Lean kernel obligation so certificates can earn
`theorem_prover_verified`; not a continuum-PDE or global-regularity claim), and
the `omnibias.pinn.solver` submodule of `omnibias-pinn` (mesh-free solver for **coupled systems of PDEs** on the
closed-form derivative tower: a `System` abstraction of coupled fields +
vector residuals + boundary/initial conditions; periodic BCs carry
`periodic_orders` defaulting to `(0, 1, 2)`, builders take opt-in
`periodic_boundary=True`, and `basis="spectral"` builds a `SpectralVectorField`
for time-dependent periodic problems; fields declare readout-independence via
`READOUT_INDEPENDENT_ATTR` so the frozen-feature linear solve can reuse
`FieldState` caches safely (nonlinear cages are refused); steady linear-collocation and
nonlinear residual-minimisation drivers -- the latter accepting the exact-curvature
optimisers of `omnibias.torch.optim` (`cubic_gauss_newton`, `gauss_newton`,
`cubic_newton`, `trust_region_newton_cg`, `jet_subspace_tensor`, `natural_gradient`)
plus `grad_norm` loss balancing, since a closed-form residual makes the matrix-free
Hessian / Gauss-Newton product exact; torch-only, `KFAC` excluded --
residual-adaptive collocation (`RefinementSpec`: grow the interior point set toward
large `abs(residual)`, measured at equal final budget) and **first-class inverse
problems** (`Unknown` coefficients recovered from `Observations` by `solve_inverse`,
constrained by construction through a softplus / scaled-sigmoid transform;
identifiability is the caller's responsibility and fails silently), a
spectral method-of-lines with a
high-order jet-Taylor time integrator, and an optional certified a-posteriori
error mode reusing `omnibias.core.verified`; exact arbitrary-order / high-order
operators in one pass, torch + jax, `unproven_claim = False`), and
`omnibias-convex` (differentiable + certified LP/QP: a closed-form-Hessian
log-barrier interior point, a KKT-differentiable `argmin` layer, a rigorous
interval optimality certificate, and a first-order **temperature-collapse** gradient-descent
solver `solve_lp_penalty`/`solve_qp_penalty` that turns each constraint hyperplane
into a tempered softplus unit with the closed-form gradient
`c + Q x + mu A^T sigma(beta (A x - b))`, annealed along a `beta`/`mu` homotopy), and
`omnibias-control` (differentiable + certified safe control: a batched, per-sample
control-barrier-function CBF-QP **safety filter** -- the temperature-collapse projection
specialised to state-dependent constraints, so it is differentiable and a policy can be
trained *through* it -- plus autodiff Lie-derivative CBF-row builders for generic
control-affine and learned-Lagrangian dynamics (`lagrangian_cbf_rows`, reusing
`omnibias-variational`), a differentiable safe rollout, and a rigorous model-relative
recoverable-set certificate via `omnibias-verify`; torch + jax twins), and
`omnibias-routing` (certified + differentiable combinatorial **routing**: a poly-size
TSP relaxation -- assignment / single-commodity-flow / Held-Karp -- solved differentiably
by the temperature-collapse penalty *unrolled* for backprop, a heatmap + 2-opt tour decoder,
and a rigorous optimality-gap certificate `lower <= optimum <= tour_cost`
(`certify_tour_gap`, Neumaier-Shcherbina verified LP bound), plus decision-focused
predict-then-optimize routing; the honest "yes-if" answer to a differentiable TSP -- a
certified gap, never a `P = NP` exactness claim; torch + jax twins), and
`omnibias-qubo` (certified + differentiable **quadratic Boolean optimization**: an
annealed sigmoid relaxation of a QUBO / Ising energy solved differentiably by the
**temperature-collapse** penalty *unrolled* for backprop, a rounding + 1-flip
local-search decoder, a brute-force oracle, and a rigorous optimality-gap certificate
`lower <= optimum <= energy` (`certify_qubo_gap`) with a headline Lasserre / SOS lower
bound over the Boolean hypercube (`omnibias-sos`) or a cheap spectral / box-QP seal
(`omnibias-convex`), plus `max_cut` and `max_independent_set` front-ends; the honest
"yes-if" answer to a differentiable QUBO -- a certified gap, never a `P = NP` exactness
claim; torch + jax twins). `omnibias-discrete` factors the shared
`encode -> relax -> decode -> certify` substrate out of `omnibias-qubo` (the
`DiscreteProblem` seam, `AnnealSchedule`, the `anneal_descent` torch + jax twins, the
rounding / k-flip decoder + brute-force oracle, and the Lasserre / SOS `certify_gap`
seeded by the always-valid `negative_coeff_lower_bound`); `omnibias-qubo` re-exports it
unchanged, and the in-tree `omnibias.discrete.maxsat` front-end (weighted CNF -> a
pseudo-Boolean `MaxSATProblem`) is its second consumer -- same honest "yes-if" certified
gap, never a `P = NP` claim. `omnibias.discrete.sparse` is a third in-tree consumer:
certified sparse recovery driven by the `l_p -> l_0` penalty-exponent collapse -- a
support-selection QUBO sealed directly by `certify_gap` (A), a continuous best-subset
problem sealed by an `omnibias-convex` box-QP bound with an OLS-residual back-stop
(`certify_best_subset_gap`, B), and a hybrid `certified_sparse_fit` that seals the
pseudo-Boolean surrogate and ships the continuous OLS refit (C); torch + jax `l_p` twins. `omnibias-logic` builds on that substrate (+ `omnibias-boolean`
+ `omnibias-sos`): it re-exports the weighted-MaxSAT surface unchanged and adds (weighted)
**#SAT / model counting** with a rigorous inclusion-exclusion **count enclosure**
`lower <= #models <= upper` (exact-arithmetic Bonferroni bounds tightening to the exact
`O(2^n)` oracle built on `omnibias-boolean`), plus a `beta -> inf` annealed model-finder
relaxation (torch + jax twins) whose decoded models are sound witness lower bounds -- the
same honest "yes-if": a certified enclosure, never a `#P` / `P = NP` claim. It also ships
**exact sound fast-paths** on the tractable fragments -- affine/XOR via `GF(2)` rank
(`xor_model_count`, unweighted), weighted bounded-treewidth DP (`treewidth_model_count`), and
a weighted component-caching #DPLL counter (`count_models_exact`) -- behind a sound-only
router (`count -> CountResult`, `guarantee in {exact, certified_enclosure}`) with optional
relaxation-warm-started branching; genuinely statistical estimators (an `(epsilon,delta)`
XOR-hashing counter and a split-conformal wrapper) are quarantined in `omnibias.logic.approx`
behind a distinct, non-forgeable `ApproxCount` (`worst_case_sound = False`) that is never
mistaken for a certified bound. A sound count `seal`s into the tamper-evident certificate v1
format and its finite obligation into the Mathlib-free Lean kernel (`seal_count_certificate`
+ `check_certificate`): a tight unweighted count as the integer identity
`Z0 - S1 + S2 - ... = #models` (certified UNSAT included), else a positive lower bound as a
satisfiability sign -- `theorem_prover_verified` earned only by a genuine `lake build`, the
kernel re-checking the finite arithmetic only (the inclusion-exclusion theorem stays a trusted
input; no `#P` / `P = NP` claim). The same certificate flows through the shared
`omnibias.core.proof` ProofMachine via a registerable `count_prover` (and the one-call
`prove_model_count`): it adjudicates an enclosure / sat / unsat / exact-count claim as
PROVED / DISPROVED / BLOCKED with an independent `O(2^n)`-oracle replay twin, and honestly
BLOCKs an exact-count claim unless the enclosure is tight.
`omnibias-nphard` is the **named-NP-hard-families** consumer of the `omnibias-qubo`
substrate: the **quadratic assignment problem** (QAP, Kronecker `Q = F (x) D` + one-hot
permutation penalty), the **generalized assignment problem** (GAP, one-hot + binary-slack
capacity encoding), and **parallel-machine scheduling** (load-variance makespan proxy) each
implement the `DiscreteProblem` seam + a `to_qubo()` reduction, so the shared annealed
relaxation, decoder and spectral / SOS `certify_gap` all apply. It adds structure-preserving
decoders (Hungarian + 2-opt for QAP, capacity-feasible rounding for GAP, argmax + LPT-repair
for scheduling), named classical baselines (`scipy.optimize.quadratic_assignment` FAQ/2-opt,
LPT, LP relaxation + greedy / optional OR-Tools CP-SAT), exponential brute-force oracles,
decision-focused training (`qap_decision_cost` backprops the true QAP cost through the
relaxation; `normalized_regret` / `spo_plus_gradient` on the linear-objective GAP), and a
from-scratch **UCT / PUCT MCTS "search track"** over a construction MDP that uses the
differentiable relaxation heatmap as an AlphaZero-style **prior** (the "Go-like" demo; on QAP
the heatmap is a *measured-weak* prior, so the demo is honestly rescoped to "search + sound
certificate", never a faked beats-uniform claim). The **certified chip-placement flagship**
(`placement_qap` + `certify_gap(kind="glb")`) frames block/macro floorplanning as the
Koopmans-Beckmann QAP and certifies it with the QAP-specific **Gilmore-Lawler bound**
(`gilmore_lawler_bound`): sound at every size (exact integer arithmetic, or outward-rounded
`omnibias.core.verified.Interval` for floats), far tighter than the spectral bound, and --
unlike the SOS SDP (dead past `N ~= 4`) -- `O(N^3)` and non-trivial at realistic block counts
(`N ~= 12-25`); scope is block-level floorplanning, never a claim of beating industrial
million-cell placers. The honest "yes-if" is the same as `omnibias-qubo` / `omnibias-routing`
and unlike the P-class
`omnibias-combinatorics`: the certified gap `lower <= optimum <= decoded` is **generally
non-tight** (a weaker bound only widens it, never asserted zero) -- a certified gap, never a
`P = NP` exactness claim; both `relaxation.py` twins + `__init__.py` are registered in
`PENALTY_FILES`, and it ships bit-identical torch + jax twins.
`omnibias-submodular` is the **monotone-submodular-maximization** consumer of the
`omnibias-discrete` substrate: it maximizes a monotone submodular `f: 2^[n] -> R>=0` over a
matroid constraint (cardinality / partition) by the **multilinear extension**
`F(p) = E_{x~p}[f(x)]` and **continuous greedy** (Frank-Wolfe over the matroid polytope; the
soft LP oracle `sigmoid(beta (g - tau))` *unrolled* for backprop so a model predicting the
coverage data trains *through* it), then **pipage / swap rounding** to a feasible integral
set `S` with the a-priori `f(S) >= (1 - 1/e) OPT` guarantee, and a rigorous marginal-gain
gap certificate `f(S) <= OPT <= U(S)` (`certify_submodular_gap`, self-checked against
`brute_force_max` on small `n`) plus a secondary unconstrained SOS bound via the shared
`certify_gap`; it ships `Coverage` (weighted max-coverage), `FacilityLocation`,
`BudgetAdditive`, `LogDeterminant` (DPP, greedy-path) and non-monotone `GraphCut` families +
a submodular algebra (`Sum` / `Scaled` / `Saturated`), accelerated greedy (`lazy_greedy`
CELF with identical output, seeded `stochastic_greedy`), a `greedy_maximize` baseline it
beats or matches, and bit-identical torch + jax twins (coverage / facility / budget /
graph-cut). Beyond cardinality / partition it covers **knapsack** budgets (`knapsack_maximize`
`1 - 1/e` + `certify_knapsack_gap`), laminar / graphic / transversal matroids +
`MatroidIntersection` (`p_matroid_greedy` `1/(p+1)`), **non-monotone** maximization
(`double_greedy` `1/2`, `measured_continuous_greedy` `1/e`), one-pass `sieve_streaming`
(`1/2 - eps`), and a `total_curvature`-sharpened ratio. It implements the `DiscreteProblem`
seam (`energy = -f`) but deliberately runs continuous greedy rather than `anneal_descent`,
since the `(1 - 1/e)` guarantee is specific to the multilinear extension; the `beta -> inf`
oracle hardening onto a `0/1` matroid-basis vertex is the feasibility / temperature sense of
"collapse", distinct from the founding `delta -> 0` bias collapse (both `relaxation.py` twins
+ `__init__.py` are registered in `PENALTY_FILES`); the honest "yes-if" is a certified
`(1 - 1/e)` approximation + gap, never a `P = NP` exactness claim. The one exact solver it
does ship is honest: unconstrained submodular *minimization* (`submodular_minimize` /
`min_norm_point`, Fujishige-Wolfe; `lovasz_extension` its convex closure) is **P-class**, so
its exactness is not a `P = NP` claim -- only the *maximization* is NP-hard.
`omnibias-combinatorics` is the **P-class** consumer of that substrate (+ `omnibias-convex`
+ `omnibias-graph`): exact **differentiable matching / flow / matroid** layers -- an
entropic / Sinkhorn relaxation onto the assignment / transportation / min-cost-flow /
matroid polytope that anneals `beta -> inf` to a polytope vertex (reusing `omnibias-graph`'s
`sinkhorn_normalize` / `soft_top_k`, not re-deriving them), a decode to a vertex,
`classical_optimum` (Hungarian / LP / max-flow / greedy) as the exact best-in-class
baseline, and a `lower <= optimum <= objective` optimality-gap certificate (`certify_gap`)
that is **tight** because these polytopes are integral (Neumaier-Shcherbina verified LP
dual via `omnibias-convex`); the honest "yes-if" is narrower here -- these problems are in
`P`, so the value-add is differentiability + the tight certificate, never a `P = NP` claim;
torch + jax twins.
`omnibias-tab` is the **tabular-learning** consumer: differentiable, exactly
second-order-trained, certified **soft decision-tree ensembles** that take on gradient
boosting (LightGBM). A tree split is a hard threshold `1[w.x > t]`; `tab` makes it a soft
oblique gate `sigmoid(beta (w.x - t))` and anneals `beta -> inf` toward a genuine hard
split -- **temperature collapse** (the feasibility sense), distinct from
the founding `delta -> 0` bias collapse (its gate / model penalty files are registered in
`PENALTY_FILES`). The model is an ensemble of oblivious soft trees whose `depth == 1` tier
is a pure sum-of-sigmoids (additive, directly certifiable) and whose `depth >= 2` tier
multiplies gates into `2**depth` leaf memberships (native feature interactions), with
bit-identical torch + jax forwards. It ships three trainers -- an exact joint second-order
driver over `omnibias.torch.optim` (`CubicNewton` / `TrustRegionNewtonCG` / `KFAC` /
`NaturalGradient`), a first-order Adam baseline, and a stagewise **Newton-boosting** driver
(the GBM-mirror: closed-form per-stage loss gradient + Hessian from the Riccati tower) --
and sound certificates (`omnibias.tab.certify`): output bounds, Lipschitz, per-feature
**monotonicity** (a certified constraint, not a soft prior), an optional sealed scalar
global-min (additive via `omnibias-verify` ingestion; multiplicative via a bespoke
outward-rounded interval / Taylor-model forward), and a certified train-soft / deploy-hard
**rounding gap** as `beta -> inf`. The honest "yes-if": you get a differentiable +
certified tree model, not an optimal hard tree (which is NP-hard); beating LightGBM is a
benchmarked claim earned per dataset (`docs/benchmarks.md`), never asserted. Builds on
`omnibias-discrete` / `-curvature` / `-verify`; torch + jax twins.
`omnibias-partition` is the light, **certified soft partition-of-unity** keystone: `depth`
oblique split gates `sigmoid(beta (w.x - t))` route an input into `2**depth` regions with
weights that are non-negative, sum to one, and **harden** to a crisp partition as
`beta -> inf` -- **temperature collapse** (the feasibility sense), distinct from the
founding `delta -> 0` bias collapse (its penalty files are in `PENALTY_FILES`). Ships a
numpy reference `partition_weights` with bit-identical torch + jax twins (parity `~1e-9`),
`hard_assignment` / `hardened_rules` (exported `if w.x > t` boundaries; `axis` mode gives
single-feature rules), a **sound** soft->hard membership-gap certificate
(`certify_partition_gap`: outward-rounded `Interval` weight enclosure + closed-form
`log(n_regions)/beta` Gibbs bound, a yes-if object), and a `RegionModels` registry whose
one `combine(X, beta) = sum_l w_l * out_l` engine is shared by four bridges as submodules
of existing packages -- `omnibias.pinn.partition` (discontinuity-capturing PINN,
`u = sum_l w_l u_l`), `omnibias.geometry.atlas` (region-wise metric `g = sum_l w_l G_l`,
convex-combo-of-SPD stays SPD), `omnibias.symbolic.piecewise` (per-region SINDy +
hybrid-automaton switch), and `omnibias.struct.decision` + `omnibias.tab.decision` (a
certified `log(N)/beta` differentiable decision layer). Depends only on `omnibias-core`
(+ optional torch/jax); products of sigmoids are differentiated by autodiff, not the
closed-form tower.
`omnibias-difference` is the founding `delta -> 0` (multi-bias collapse) register for
**discrete calculus / analytic combinatorics**: `K` biases on a difference stencil coalesce
as `delta -> 0` so the finite difference *becomes* the derivative `sigma^(K-1)`, which the
closed-form tower evaluates exactly (no `1/delta^(K-1)` cancellation). It ships certified
finite-difference -> derivative extraction (interval-tower enclosure + a certified
Taylor-remainder bound), umbral / Sheffer calculus (finite differences, Newton
interpolation, Stirling transforms, plus Sheffer / associated sequence *generation* and the
umbral operator layer -- shift / delta / Pincherle / umbral functional -- in the
`omnibias.difference.umbral` namespace), and asymptotic-coefficient reading --
Stirling (off `omnibias.core.bell`), Bernoulli (off the `tanh` tower) and Euler (off a new
`sech` tower) numbers, exact as `int` / `Fraction` with mpmath-checked asymptotics -- plus
bit-identical torch + jax twins of the finite-difference stencil operator. It is also the
home of an all-tiers **data-driven refinement program** (probes with grid+random soundness,
an mpmath oracle, `K >= 8` seeds and a named baseline; harness in
`omnibias.difference.validation`, umbrella smoke `docs/examples/difference_validate.py`):
a certified Euler-Maclaurin summation engine + `log_gamma`/`digamma` and exact
`zeta(2m)`/`zeta(1-2m)`/`beta(2m+1)` with an attempted (numerical) critical-strip
continuation in `omnibias.core.verified`; certificate-sealed, Lean-checkable derivative
enclosures and special-number identities (`theorem_prover_verified` only on a real `lake`
pass); certified analytic-combinatorics enclosures (`generating`); and cross-package
bridges -- discrete recurrence discovery in `omnibias-symbolic`, certified PDE-stencil
truncation in `omnibias-verify`, and a sigma-tower vector-field bridge into
`omnibias-dynamics`. This is the `delta -> 0` *derivative* sense of collapse, never the
`beta -> inf` feasibility penalty.
`omnibias-qcalculus` is the **quantum / q-calculus** extension of the difference register:
exact q-combinatorics (`[n]_q`, `[n]_q!`, Gaussian / q-binomial, q-Pochhammer as `Fraction`
or integer polynomials in `q`), the Jackson q-derivative / q-integral, the two q-exponentials
and q-deformed Bernoulli / Euler numbers, basic hypergeometric series `_r phi_s` with a
certified geometric tail, and a q-umbral / q-Sheffer layer (`omnibias.qcalculus.umbral`:
q-Stirling numbers + q-falling/rising bases, q-binomial / q-Stirling transforms, q-Newton
interpolation on the `[j]_q` nodes, and q-Appell / general `q_sheffer_sequence` generation
carrying the exact `Q s_n = [n]_q s_{n-1}` recurrence, all reducing to
`omnibias.difference.umbral` as `q -> 1`), plus bit-identical torch + jax
Jackson-derivative twins. Its
collapse is the **`q -> 1`** limit (`[n]_q -> n`, `D_q f -> f'`, `e_q -> exp`) -- a *distinct*
limit from the founding `delta -> 0` bias collapse of `omnibias-difference` and the
`beta -> inf` feasibility penalty, same spirit, different parameter, never conflated. Honesty:
q-combinatorics / polynomial operators / q-B / q-E are `closed-form`, the callable Jackson
operators and direct q-series are `numerical`, and the q-exponential / basic-hypergeometric
enclosures are `numerical (certified)`. Smoke `docs/examples/qcalculus_validate.py`.
`omnibias-timescale` is **time-scale (Hilger) calculus**: one calculus over an arbitrary
closed subset of the reals -- `TimeScale` for `R`, `hZ`, `q^Z u {0}` and finite sets (jump
operators `sigma` / `rho`, graininess `mu` / `nu`); `delta` / `nabla` derivatives whose
`delta_derivative_tower` **dispatches** to the closed-form derivative tower on `R`, the forward
difference on `hZ`, and the Jackson q-derivative on the quantum scale; the delta integral, the
Hilger exponential + regressive `circle-plus` group, and linear dynamic equations; with
bit-identical torch + jax delta-derivative twins. It is the founding `delta -> 0` bias collapse
**generalized** -- the graininess limit `mu -> 0` recovers the continuum tower -- a distinct
limit from qcalculus's `q -> 1` and the `beta -> inf` penalty, carried honestly and registered
in the `FOUNDING_FILES` terminology guard. Smoke `docs/examples/timescale_validate.py`.
`omnibias-holonomic` is the **D-finite computer-algebra engine + Lean-certified identities**
capstone: a genuine right-Euclidean Ore (skew-polynomial) algebra for the shift `S` and
differential `D` operators (`ore_divmod` / `gcrd` / `lclm` / `symmetric_product`); `DFinite` /
`PRecursive` objects closed under sum / Hadamard **symbolically for all `n`** (verified-ansatz
fallback) plus Cauchy product; Gosper's algorithm for unconditional closed-form hypergeometric
summation (non-summable terms *refused*); **true Zeilberger + WZ** (`zeilberger`, `wz_pair` on
exact bivariate `ProperTerm`s -- a telescoper `L` + rational cofactor `R(n,k)` from one exact
null space, degenerate sums like `sum (-1)^k C(n,k)=[n=0]` handled natively); **Petkovsek's
`hyper`** (all hypergeometric-term solutions of a shift recurrence, on a scoped rational-root
`factor` substrate); a **q-holonomic** bridge (`q_gosper` / `q_zeilberger` on
`omnibias-qcalculus`, exact q-rational certificates at a fixed rational `q`, the `q -> 1`
*distinct* limit); exact **D-finite ⇔ P-recursive transforms** + closures
(`dfinite_derivative` / `dfinite_integral` / `dfinite_compose_poly`); `guess_dfinite` /
`guess_algebraic` (guessed-then-verified); `precursive_asymptotics` (Poincare-Perron leading
rate / exponent, `numerical`, `certified_asymptotic` bridging `difference.transfer_theorem`);
and `prove_hypergeometric_identity` / `prove_identity_zeilberger`, discharging classic binomial
identities as per-coefficient `rational_identity` obligations the omnibias Lean kernel checks --
the Zeilberger path's `P(n,k)==0` grid proving the identity for **all** `n` (`HolonomicProof.all_n`).
`theorem_prover_verified` is earned only on a genuine `lake` pass, never forged, degrading
gracefully with no toolchain. Ore algebra / symbolic closures / Zeilberger sums / transforms /
certificate payloads are `closed-form for all n`; `factor` is scoped to the rational-root /
linear regime; *which* annihilator a guessed sum obeys is `guessed` then verified; asymptotics is
`numerical`. Builds on `omnibias-difference` (probe harness + transfer theorem),
`omnibias-qcalculus` (q-primitives), `omnibias-symbolic` (recurrence guessing) and the
`omnibias.core.proof` Lean loop. Smoke `docs/examples/holonomic_validate.py`.
`omnibias-struct` is the **dynamic-programming** register of the `beta -> inf` family:
certified differentiable **soft Viterbi / shortest-path / CTC**, where the DP `max`
combine becomes `lse_beta` (so `lse_beta -> max` as `beta -> inf`, annealing to exact hard
DP -- the feasibility axis) and is differentiated *exactly* by the `delta -> 0` founding
bias collapse tower (`softplus^(n) = sigma^(n-1)` propagated through `compose_jet` gives
closed-form log-sum-exp / softmax jets; the soft-DP gradient is the forward-backward path
marginal). It ships a closed-form `V* <= V_beta <= V* + log(N)/beta` gap certificate
self-checked against brute-force hard DP, with bit-identical torch + jax twins -- the same
honest "yes-if": a certified gap that shrinks with `beta`, never an exactness claim. The
same substrate carries the application layers **soft-DTW, sequence alignment (global,
local Smith-Waterman, affine-gap Gotoh), soft value iteration / planning, monotonic
alignment search, and structured attention**. A **semiring / hypergraph driver**
(`Hypergraph` + `MaxPlus`/`Log`/`Counting` semirings) generalises the whole substrate --
every DP is a semiring reduction over a weighted hypergraph's derivations, and the driver
reproduces the hand-written soft-DP layers bit-for-bit (the additive-safety proof) -- so
the **tree / grammar families** lift onto it with no bespoke recursion: **CKY
inside-outside parsing**, **Eisner projective dependency** parsing, and the **matrix-tree**
non-projective marginals (an *exact* Kirchhoff-determinant partition, honestly not an
`lse_beta` relaxation, with the `beta -> inf` gap taken against the max arborescence). On
top sit the **distribution operators** -- path entropy, exact forward-filtering
backward-sampling, and exact k-best (+ a top-k-restricted free energy). It also ships exact
higher-order and second-order derivatives *through* the DP recursion (`dp_value_jet`,
`hypergraph_lse_jet` / `cky_lse_jet` / `eisner_lse_jet`, + a torch curvature / HVP bridge);
a **verified interval** enclosure of `V_beta` (`omnibias.struct.verified`, outward-rounded
from `omnibias.core.verified`, now covering DTW / alignment / CTC values, certified
forward-backward marginals, and the interval matrix-tree determinant); and a sealed,
optionally Lean-checkable **certified-decoding** proof that the decoded path's
winner-vs-runner-up margin stays `> 0` over an input `epsilon`-ball (chain and DAG /
`omnibias.struct.decode`). A **certified argmax / measure-mode collapse** submodule
(`omnibias.struct.select`) closes the `beta -> inf` collapse of a Gibbs law onto its mode:
`certify_argmax` seals a `SelectionCertificate` (value gap `log(N)/beta`, the mode-mass lower
bound `p_max >= 1/(1+(N-1)e^{-beta m})` checked against the exact `p_max`, and the optional
`L^inf` argmax-stability radius `m/2`), with backend twins for the differentiable
`soft_argmax` and the exact Gibbs moments (`gibbs_mean` / `gibbs_covariance` /
`gibbs_cumulants_directional` via the log-partition `compose_jet`). A data-driven probe harness
+ committed refinement sweep (`docs/benchmarks/struct_refinement.json`) back every claim with a
measured verdict.

- [PINN conservation cages + non-local attention field](docs/examples/pinn_conservation_attention.py)
- [PINN domain decomposition (XPINN) + stiff integrators](docs/examples/pinn_xpinn_stiff.py)
- [PINN partition of unity across an interface (soft partition captures a kink a single smooth field cannot; certified soft->hard gap)](docs/examples/partitioned_pinn.py)
- [Conservative shock-capturing Burgers PINN (flux-form cage over a partitioned potential: div G = 0 to machine epsilon across a sharp moving seam, and tighter global mass balance than a non-conservative arm at equal budget as the layer goes under-resolved; conservation is structural, accuracy is optimised, entropy admissibility is out of scope)](docs/examples/pinn_burgers_shock.py)
- [Hard boundary / initial conditions for PINNs (constrained-expression cage: Dirichlet / Neumann / Robin / initial-velocity / periodic-seam conditions satisfied identically for any parameters, over any number of axes with exact edges and corners; support-matrix invertibility sealed as a certificate, incompatible cross-axis data refused at construction, and solver auto-detection that deletes the absorbed rows from the loss; for time-dependent periodic spatial axes prefer `basis="spectral"` / `SpectralVectorField`)](docs/examples/pinn_hard_conditions.py)
- [PINN operator learning (DeepONet with closed-form query-coordinate trunk jet through order 4 so a shipped KS residual costs one jet; ks_residual_loss_fd 5-point twin; Burgers bake-off honest-negative vs FD-u_t; KS bake-off median-win but seed-fragile vs ≥6/8 rule; measured FD accuracy floor; shared-grid scaling; FNO remains FFT-based/periodic; residual enclosure over a sensor/coefficient family is sound but not a solution-error bound; operator accuracy is optimised not proven; sense 3 of docs/operator-surface.md, not OperatorBlock)](docs/examples/pinn_operator_learning.py)
- [PINN causal time marching (`omnibias.pinn.train.march_solve`)](docs/examples/pinn_causal_marching.py)
- [PINN SDF hard BC on a disk (`omnibias.pinn.domain`)](docs/examples/pinn_sdf_geometry.py)
- [PINN FBPINN multi-window field + spectral-bias index](docs/examples/pinn_fbpinn.py)
- [QPINN harmonic oscillator](docs/examples/qpinn_tise_qho.py)

- [PDE solver: coupled reaction-diffusion](docs/examples/pde_reaction_diffusion.py)
- [Convex LP by gradient descent (bias collapse)](docs/examples/convex_lp_gradient_descent.py)
- [Certified-safe learned control (learned-Lagrangian CBF filter)](docs/examples/control_learned_lagrangian_cbf.py)
- [Certified differentiable decision-focused routing (TSP)](docs/examples/decision_focused_routing_tsp.py)
- [Certified differentiable QUBO / max-cut (relax -> decode -> certify, + backprop-through-opt)](docs/examples/certified_differentiable_qubo.py)
- [Certified differentiable submodular maximization (continuous greedy + pipage rounding, (1-1/e) sandwich vs brute force + train-through)](docs/examples/certified_differentiable_submodular.py)
- [Submodular function families & constraints (lazy/stochastic greedy on a log-det DPP + certified gap; budgeted-knapsack coverage; non-monotone max-cut via double greedy; exact P-class submodular_minimize vs brute force)](docs/examples/submodular_families_and_constraints.py)
- [Certified differentiable NP-hard (QAP sandwich vs scipy quadratic_assignment + train-through)](docs/examples/certified_differentiable_nphard.py)

- [Certified chip placement (QAP floorplanning: Gilmore-Lawler GLB <= optimum <= decoded wirelength, scales past brute/SOS, vs scipy + place-through-the-solver)](docs/examples/certified_chip_placement.py)
- [Certified differentiable matching (Sinkhorn relax -> decode -> tight LP-dual gap sandwiching Hungarian + train-through)](docs/examples/certified_differentiable_matching.py)
- [Certified + differentiable Boolean logic (MaxSAT gap + #SAT count enclosure sandwiching the exact oracle)](docs/examples/certified_logic_maxsat_sharpsat.py)
- [Exact #SAT fast-paths + sound router + a sealed Lean-checkable count certificate + a quarantined statistical layer (affine/treewidth/DPLL agree with the oracle; seal -> verify -> kernel-check; ApproxMC + conformal stay non-sound)](docs/examples/logic_exact_and_approx_counting.py)
- [Certified differentiable dynamic programming (soft Viterbi / shortest-path, log(N)/beta gap + brute-force agreement, backprop-through-DP + tower marginals)](docs/examples/certified_soft_dp.py)
- [Certified lattice mass gap (sound lower bound on a fixed transfer matrix, sandwiched by the effective-mass curve, sealed + Lean-ready, cross-checked against a Monte Carlo of the same matrix; fixed-spacing only, never a continuum or Yang-Mills claim)](docs/examples/gauge_certified_mass_gap.py)
